source: Now father urges me too? “With a Snail Lord you will have everything you want! You will be most comfortable.” Byek! Must everything be an exchange? And Sharoof is such a slugshite! The only reason I joined father to travel this far from the capital was to escape its greed and lust and raving thirst for blood. I don’t even care about the crowded bathhouse, the awful flute bands, the laughable spice market. Give me peace, interesting conversation, and a mirror for hairsculpting, and I’ll be steady. Of course, father reslishes his promotion to Master of Currency in the Mire Lands. His pride is the size of a grass-fattened war snail. I understand it… he alone breeds the Red Massuma snails, hollows the shells and dries them, paints the face of Massuma on each, and hardens the lot into currency with his special pine resin. Important work in the empire I suppose, but so… heartless. There is no poetry around here. Money, money, money. Earn it, spend it, sleep, repeat. Everyone lives for money. Except that oddslug who gave it all up. The builder of the Judgment Pit – what’s his name? Right, Kwyn. A poor storyteller of unburied items. Children adore him. I’ve never seen a man wilfully relinquish his position from Soledfolk to Mudfoot. Perhaps I’ll offer to pomp his hair in exchange for a peek into his mind. I am starved for something interesting.

今天有驚人的發現！我在灰石丘山腳的松林沼澤，注意到一座奇怪土丘。那座山曾被水淹，如今已不再叫海豹島。前夜大雨沖走大量泥土，露出埋藏建築，所用混凝土比最高級蝸領主宅邸的還精緻。然而，這不是廢棄宮殿，而是淺海時代之前密封的空間。歷史寶藏似乎無窮無盡。蕾雅一定會喜歡。

source:
Allomother Emya of Living Beings,
Allofather Snahoon of Sun and Rain,
May this prayer rise to meet you
Upon this smoke of burning hair
Cut from my head like stalks of wild rice 
That feed us from the mud.

I do not pray often. I know. But I am reminded of your life-giving gifts as I am pregnant through the touch of my beloved Kwyn. 

Happiness lifts my soul. Worry weighs my mind. 

Kwyn is home to my heart. A peaceful man who lives for sharing knowledge and understanding the mysteries of the past. Though, I have not told father of our love. My father is a strong provider but a narrow thinker who bows to rich Lords in hopes of slaking his desire for status and comfort. Please soften his mind and heart. I know this wasn’t the plan he had for me. 

I ask for protection of my child. I ask for protection from men with hearts as cold as Massushells. 

Allomother, Allofather:
 May this prayer rise to meet you.
 May this prayer rise to meet you.
target:
眾生之母艾米雅，
日雨之父斯納洪，
願此祈禱升向祢們，
乘著燃髮之煙。
髮絲自頭頂剪落，如野稻莖，
自泥中養育我們。

我知道，我很少祈禱。但摯愛奎恩的觸碰，讓我懷了孩子，也使我想起祢們賜予生命的恩惠。

幸福托起靈魂，憂慮壓著心。

奎恩是我心的歸宿。他平和，為分享知識、理解過去的謎團而活。但我尚未告訴父親我們的愛。父親善於養家，思想卻狹隘，向有錢領主低頭，只盼滿足對地位與安逸的渴望。請柔軟他的心思。我知道，這不是他替我安排的路。

我祈求保護我的孩子，祈求免受那些心如馬蘇貝幣般冰冷的人傷害。

願此祈禱升向祢們。
